title: Wood shoe horn
text: Wood shoe horn. Wow.  This is the most beautiful shoe horn I have ever seen.  It's beautiful wood - not "junk" wood but some sort of hard wood that has been beautifully prepared.  It's thick... smooth and dark in color..  My husband chose it.  It's thick enough that I believe it will last for some time.  I am hoping it will not be brittle- but I believe it will be good.  It's really long... eyeballing it (I can't find my tape measure for some reason) about 3ft or so (?) It has a very nicely carved (?) handle area that is narrowed so that it's easier to hold on to.  Then, of course, it's splayed at the bottom, thinner - so that you can slide your heel right over it into your shoe. It's just really beautiful as well as functional.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  I hope this was helpful to you in your shopping decision!
